target.statement: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct + SEALONG achieves 55.0 average SubEM on long-context tasks (Qasper, MultiFieldQA-En, HotpotQA, MuSiQue, 2WikiMQA)

compute.basis: Requires sampling 32 outputs for 2048 long-context examples (up to 32K tokens) with an 8B model, then fine-tuning with sequence parallelism on 8 H100 GPUs; even with QLoRA, CPU-only inference and training would be prohibitively slow.

blockers: Requires 8×H100 GPUs for fine-tuning as per paper
Long-context (32K) sampling and training are extremely slow on CPU
No GPU available on target laptop
title: Large Language Models Can Self-Improve in Long-context Reasoning
